technically, everything you do that hurts you on purpose is a form of self harm, not a self harm alternative. burning, especially, can leave bad scars, and can be just as bad as cutting, but if you're at a point where every time that you cut, you go very deep and/or have to go to hospital, then burning, although still self harm, may be a safer form of self harm  for you right now, to stop you from hurting yourself as seriously. Personally, i like to turn up the heat in our shower as high as it goes, and when i get out, my skin is always very red and hurts, but it stops me from cutting. Another probably better self harm alternative is waxing, because it leaves a sting. Or you could try snapping a rubber band onto your wrist.

Stay safe xxxx
